sources.title: Media Fragments URI 1.0 (basic)
sources.observed_operation: Opened official Recommendation; checked temporal syntax and validity.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Intervals are half-open; omitted begin/end default to 0/duration; hh:mm:ss does not signal frame accuracy.
sources.applicability: Supports interval convention and optional fragment export only; not local identity or decoder precision.

sources.title: Web Annotation Data Model
sources.locator: §4.2.2 Fragment Selector; §4.2.5 Text Position Selector lines 973-993; State
sources.observed_operation: Opened Recommendation; checked selector definitions, character boundaries and stale-anchor warning.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Text positions are zero-based and start-inclusive/end-exclusive; edits make positions brittle and State can identify the representation.
sources.applicability: Optional text navigation/interchange only; does not create audio synchronization. Corrects investigator locator §4.2.10 to §4.2.5.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2
sources.observed_operation: Opened Recommendation; checked keyboard, color, focus and status-message criteria.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Normative for applicable web content; SC 4.1.3 covers programmatically exposed markup status messages without focus changes.
sources.applicability: Supports keyboard/non-color/focus goals; native accessibility behavior still depends on the selected toolkit/platform.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG Slider Pattern
sources.locator: About/warning lines 24-26; media seek example lines 29-32; keys lines 33-52
sources.observed_operation: Opened APG page; checked slider key/value conventions and touch-AT warning.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: APG is informative; arrows change by step, Home/End set endpoints, page keys are optional; AT testing is advised.
sources.applicability: Supports optional slider plus fields/buttons, not a complete accessible annotation editor.

sources.title: Peaks.js API Documentation
sources.locator: Keyboard options lines 573-581; Segments API; player/waveform APIs
sources.observed_operation: Opened pinned API docs; checked keyboard defaults/nudge, segment API and waveform data.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Keyboard binding defaults false; nudge is 0.01 seconds. API does not establish accessible segment authoring.
sources.applicability: Visual candidate only. Release-status evidence is separately recorded as SRC-015.

sources.title: Peaks.js v3.4.2 demo caller
sources.locator: Segment table near lines 1760-1800; config around 1978-2004
sources.observed_operation: Opened tagged caller; checked numeric fields, actions, keyboard opt-in and dataUri.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Demo shows list/time fields/actions, keyboard:true and precomputed dataUri; not an accessibility claim.
sources.applicability: Concrete caller pattern only; no production, performance or conformance guarantee.

sources.title: WaveSurfer.js Regions plugin source
sources.locator: RegionParams lines 2326-2373; constructor 2533-2545; drag streams; API 3605-3620
sources.observed_operation: Opened pinned source and searched for pointer/drag and keyboard handlers.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: IDs may be passed; times are seconds; absent end becomes start; drag/resize default true. Searched file had pointer/drag code and no keydown match.
sources.applicability: Absence of a keydown match is scoped to this file; host controls remain necessary.

sources.title: WaveSurfer.js release history
sources.released_version_or_commit: Release history accessed 2026-10-12; includes v8.0.0 at a1cdffd
sources.observed_operation: Opened release history; checked notes for early seek, post-pause timeupdate, hidden-container NaN seek, race and adjacent region behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release notes report fixes; they are not application-specific accessibility or fidelity tests.
sources.applicability: Regression cases for a prototype only; no claim proposed integration was tested.

sources.title: Audacity Manual: Label Tracks
sources.released_version_or_commit: Rolling online manual; no release tag on page
sources.locator: Limits lines 32-35; navigation 81-94; Label Editor 144-148; export behavior
sources.observed_operation: Opened manual; checked point/region labels, keyboard navigation, table editor, export and limits.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Tab/Shift+Tab navigation and keyboard-accessible Label Editor documented; >260 chars may not reload; hundreds/thousands may slow; Export Multiple uses uppermost label track.
sources.applicability: Workflow precedent, not embedded library; limits warrant caution about scale/export.

sources.title: GStreamer Seeking design documentation
sources.observed_operation: Opened official design page; checked accurate versus key-unit behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Without ACCURATE, approximate seeks may occur; ACCURATE requires requested stream-relative position and may require processing from start; KEY_UNIT changes segment start.
sources.applicability: Backend example only; no runtime or universal codec guarantee.

sources.title: AVPlayer precise seek method (investigator URL)
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current Apple AVFoundation docs; SDK/runtime unpinned
sources.observed_operation: Exact assigned URL returned internal error in review browser; official Apple pages checked separately as SRC-013 and SRC-014.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Original identity preserved; separate records verify the tolerance and interruption claims.
sources.applicability: Do not silently rebind this source ID.

sources.title: Web Audio API 1.1
sources.observed_operation: Opened spec; inspected encoded input, PCM decode and AudioBuffer behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: decodeAudioData consumes encoded ArrayBuffer data and decodes to linear PCM; if multiple audio tracks exist it decodes only the first.
sources.applicability: Relevant to Web Audio candidate and long-file profiling only.

sources.title: Apple AVPlayer seek with tolerances
sources.observed_operation: Read official Apple search result and linked page.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Landing may vary within supplied tolerance; zero tolerances request sample-accurate seek and may add decoding delay.
sources.applicability: Backend example only if AVFoundation is selected.

sources.title: Apple AVPlayer seek completion handler
sources.observed_operation: Read official Apple search result and linked page.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A seek already in progress can complete finished=false when another seek interrupts it.
sources.applicability: Supports adapter completion state only if AVPlayer is selected.

sources.title: Peaks.js release history
sources.observed_operation: Opened upstream release list and checked v4.0.0-beta.2 status and v3.4.2 tag/commit.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: v4.0.0-beta.2 is marked prerelease; v3.4.2 is a release at 8144d61.
sources.applicability: Direct evidence for release-status claims; supplements pinned API/caller records.
